item.text:
| Feature | Offer A | Offer B |
|---|---|---|
| Annual cost, excluding sales tax | CAD 1,100 | CAD 1,440 (CAD 120 × 12) |
| Device allowance | 6 | 10 |
| Support | Email | Phone |
| Annual cost per device at full capacity | CAD 183.33 | CAD 144 |

Offer B costs **CAD 340 more per year**, allows four additional devices, and provides phone rather than email support. Its lower per-device cost applies only when all included devices are used.

Neither offer is inherently better: the choice depends on the buyer’s device count and support needs, which have not been specified.
